summary: Iteration 35: Tested HeartLink Smart Notification System (admin notification-config, analytics-chart, welcome + new_user_discovery gating) end-to-end. Backend: 17 pytest tests (12 API contract + 5 real signup E2E gating tests) — 16 passed, 1 failed (no server-side range validation on max_notifications_per_user_per_day). Frontend: full UI flow via public URL — login as admin -> /admin -> Notifications tab -> SmartNotificationConfig renders with stats strip, 7-day chart, frequency +/- control (clamped 1-10), all 7 toggle cards; Save appears on change, PUT succeeds, toast shows, value + toggle state persist after reload. Found one pre-existing 500 (GET /api/admin/notification-templates) in the same Notifications tab.

critical.issue: Returns 500 KeyError: 'message' (server.py:6621 reads value['message'] but fcm_service.ENGAGEMENT_TEMPLATES entries use key 'body'). Breaks NotificationManager in the same Notifications tab — console shows 'Failed to fetch templates AxiosError' on every load. Fix: use value.get('body') (or value.get('message') or value.get('body')).

minor.issue: max_notifications_per_user_per_day has no server-side range validation — accepts 9999 (and negatives) with 200. UI clamps 1-10 but API does not. Add int bounds check (1-10) or Pydantic model.

New analytics/frequency logic writes to collection 'notification_log' (singular) while the rest of the app logs to 'notification_logs' (plural, 30 existing docs). Result: chart/recent_24h/type_breakdown ignore all other notification types, and the per-user daily cap (can_notify) does not count notifications sent by other code paths, so the frequency limit is not actually enforced app-wide.

'analytics' is {} because notification_analytics counters are only incremented by the 6-hourly scheduler; the welcome and new_user_discovery paths log to notification_log but never $inc notification_analytics — so the '<n> sent' badge on toggle cards will always be 0 for those two types.
No authentication/authorization — AdminAuthMiddleware is in pass-through mode, so any anonymous caller can read and flip all notification toggles (verified via plain curl with no token).

integration_issues.issue: notification-templates 500 surfaces only as a console error; NotificationManager shows no visible error state to the admin

issues: 7-day chart x-axis labels show only the day number (d.date.split(' ')[1]) so month context is lost across month boundaries (shows 30, 31, 01, 02...)
When all totals are 0 the chart renders as a flat 3px line with '0' labels and no empty-state message
fetchConfig/fetchChart failures are swallowed with console.error only — no error/retry UI (loading skeleton would clear into an empty card)

action_items: Add server-side validation (1-10) for max_notifications_per_user_per_day in PUT /api/admin/notification-config
Unify notification_log vs notification_logs collections so analytics/chart and the daily frequency cap cover all notification types
Increment notification_analytics counters (or read from notification_log) so the 'n sent' badges are meaningful
Consider requiring admin auth on /api/admin/notification-config (currently open to anonymous callers)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:6621 dereferences value['message'] on ENGAGEMENT_TEMPLATES entries that only define 'body' — guaranteed 500.
Two parallel notification log collections (notification_log / notification_logs) is a silent correctness bug for both analytics and spam capping.
PUT /admin/notification-config takes a raw Request dict instead of a Pydantic model — no type/range validation (int(v) on a non-numeric string would also raise an unhandled 500).
SmartNotificationConfig.jsx has no error state for failed GETs; loading skeleton resolves to an empty card on failure.
seed_data_creation: E2E tests create throwaway users test_notif_*/test_disc_*@heartlinktest.com by upserting a verified signup_otps record, then delete the users, their notification_log/notifications and new_user_notif_log docs in module teardown. notification_config was restored to all-toggles-true / max=3 after both suites and after UI testing (verified via GET).
test_credentials: shivamkks112@gmail.com / Shivam@2026 (used for UI admin login; worked). Login payload field is 'email_or_phone'. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present and accurate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_smart_notif_iter35.py (API contract, fast) and /app/backend/tests/test_smart_notif_e2e_iter35.py (~25s, real signups; needs MONGO_URL from backend/.env to seed verified OTP because /api/auth/signup requires a verified signup_otps record). Admin notification endpoints need NO auth token — curl works directly. UI path: /auth -> login-tab-btn -> login-email-input/login-password-input -> login-submit-btn -> goto /admin -> click [data-testid="admin-notifications-tab"] (testid added by me) -> [data-testid="smart-notification-config"]. Save button testids: notif-config-save (header, only when dirty) and notif-config-save-bottom. notif-type-breakdown block only renders when type_breakdown_24h is non-empty (it is empty when notification_log has no docs in last 24h).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) notification-templates 500: server.py get_all_notification_templates() builds body from value['message'] but fcm_service.ENGAGEMENT_TEMPLATES uses 'body' -> KeyError (confirmed in backend.err.log traceback). 2) Frequency limit unvalidated: update_notification_config casts int(v) with no bounds, so 9999 persisted (test restored to 3). 3) Zeroed analytics: new welcome/new_user_discovery logging targets db.notification_log while legacy code writes db.notification_logs (30 docs), so chart/recent_24h read an almost-empty collection. Feature gating itself is correct: with welcome_enabled=false no welcome log/notification is created, with new_user_discovery_enabled=false the background _notify_new_user_joined returns early — both verified with real signups.
